This analysis is retained in the public repository for transparency and is not
reported in the manuscript or supplementary materials.

This report estimates the complete Step 3 Distress model. Core, Peripheral,
and the three raw-minute Engagement Time modes enter simultaneously at the
within-person and between-person levels. The model uses the exact 17,755-prompt
sample used in S3.3. Coefficient-pattern comparisons therefore reflect
engagement adjustment rather than changing rows. A same-variable-set model with
all six duration paths fixed to zero supplies the nested MLR test. Adjustment is
not interpreted as causal mediation.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
public_model_diagnostics <- function(data) {
  if ("warning_summary" %in% names(data) && !"warning_text" %in% names(data)) return(data)
  warning_text <- as.character(data$warning_text)
  stopifnot(length(warning_text) == nrow(data))
  output <- data[, setdiff(names(data), c("warning_text", "error_text")), drop = FALSE]
  output$warning_summary <- ifelse(
    grepl("following clusters|cluster IDs", warning_text, ignore.case = TRUE),
    "Includes a within-cluster variation warning; individual details remain private",
    ifelse(nzchar(warning_text), "Other warning; details retained locally", "None")
  )
  output
}

locate_project_root <- function(start = getwd()) {
  current <- normalizePath(start, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
  if (!dir.exists(current)) current <- dirname(current)
  repeat {
    if (all(dir.exists(file.path(current, c(
      "Step_1_Descriptive_and_Reliability",
      "Step_3_Concurrent_Multilevel_Associations"
    ))))) return(current)
    parent <- dirname(current)
    if (identical(parent, current)) break
    current <- parent
  }
  stop("Could not locate the project from its public Step directories")
}

load_single_object <- function(path, expected_name) {
  environment <- new.env(parent = emptyenv())
  loaded <- load(path, envir = environment)
  if (!identical(loaded, expected_name)) {
    stop(
      "Expected only ", expected_name, " in ", path,
      "; found: ", paste(loaded, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }
  environment[[expected_name]]
}

mplus_numeric <- function(x) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(x)))

summary_value <- function(summary_row, candidates, type = c("numeric", "character")) {
  type <- match.arg(type)
  hit <- intersect(candidates, names(summary_row))
  if (!length(hit)) return(if (type == "numeric") NA_real_ else NA_character_)
  value <- summary_row[[hit[[1L]]]][[1L]]
  if (type == "numeric") mplus_numeric(value) else as.character(value)
}

flatten_messages <- function(x) {
  if (is.null(x) || !length(x)) return("")
  paste(unlist(x, recursive = TRUE, use.names = FALSE), collapse = " | ")
}

parse_output_integer <- function(path, label) {
  lines <- readLines(path, warn = FALSE)
  hit <- grep(label, lines, ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE, fixed = TRUE)
  if (!length(hit)) return(NA_integer_)
  numbers <- regmatches(hit[[1L]], gregexpr("[0-9]+", hit[[1L]]))[[1L]]
  if (!length(numbers)) NA_integer_ else as.integer(tail(numbers, 1L))
}

round_numeric_columns <- function(data, digits = 4L) {
  data |>
    dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, digits)))
}

vif_table <- function(data, variables, level_label, model_label) {
  x <- as.data.frame(data[stats::complete.cases(data[variables]), variables, drop = FALSE])
  dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(variables, function(target) {
    others <- setdiff(variables, target)
    fit <- stats::lm(stats::reformulate(others, response = target), data = x)
    r_squared <- summary(fit)$r.squared
    data.frame(
      model = model_label, level = level_label, variable = target,
      r_squared_from_other_predictors = r_squared,
      vif = 1 / (1 - r_squared), stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }))
}

condition_index <- function(data, variables) {
  x <- data[stats::complete.cases(data[variables]), variables, drop = FALSE]
  correlation <- stats::cor(x)
  eigenvalues <- eigen(correlation, symmetric = TRUE, only.values = TRUE)$values
  sqrt(max(eigenvalues) / min(eigenvalues))
}

skewness <- function(x) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (length(x) < 3L || stats::sd(x) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  mean((x - mean(x))^3) / stats::sd(x)^3
}

excess_kurtosis <- function(x) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (length(x) < 4L || stats::sd(x) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  mean((x - mean(x))^4) / stats::sd(x)^4 - 3
}

style_and_sanitize_workbook <- function(path, sheet_data) {
  workbook <- openxlsx::loadWorkbook(path)
  header_style <- openxlsx::createStyle(
    fontName = "Aptos", fontSize = 10, textDecoration = "bold",
    fontColour = "#FFFFFF", fgFill = "#1F4E78",
    halign = "center", valign = "center", wrapText = TRUE,
    border = "bottom", borderColour = "#163A5C"
  )
  body_style <- openxlsx::createStyle(
    fontName = "Aptos", fontSize = 10, valign = "top", wrapText = TRUE
  )
  integer_style <- openxlsx::createStyle(numFmt = "0")
  decimal_style <- openxlsx::createStyle(numFmt = "0.0000")

  for (sheet_name in names(sheet_data)) {
    data <- sheet_data[[sheet_name]]
    row_count <- nrow(data) + 1L
    column_count <- ncol(data)
    openxlsx::showGridLines(workbook, sheet = sheet_name, showGridLines = FALSE)
    openxlsx::freezePane(workbook, sheet = sheet_name, firstRow = TRUE)
    openxlsx::setRowHeights(workbook, sheet = sheet_name, rows = 1L, heights = 30)
    openxlsx::addStyle(
      workbook, sheet = sheet_name, style = header_style,
      rows = 1L, cols = seq_len(column_count), gridExpand = TRUE, stack = TRUE
    )
    if (row_count > 1L) {
      openxlsx::addStyle(
        workbook, sheet = sheet_name, style = body_style,
        rows = 2L:row_count, cols = seq_len(column_count),
        gridExpand = TRUE, stack = TRUE
      )
    }
    integer_columns <- which(
      vapply(data, is.integer, logical(1)) |
        names(data) %in% c(
          "observations", "clusters", "free_parameters", "df", "df_difference",
          "errors_n", "warnings_n", "required_focal_paths",
          "required_duration_paths", "required_contrasts", "n", "rank",
          "endpoint_300_count", "n_observed"
        )
    )
    numeric_columns <- setdiff(which(vapply(data, is.numeric, logical(1))), integer_columns)
    if (row_count > 1L && length(integer_columns)) {
      openxlsx::addStyle(
        workbook, sheet = sheet_name, style = integer_style,
        rows = 2L:row_count, cols = integer_columns,
        gridExpand = TRUE, stack = TRUE
      )
    }
    if (row_count > 1L && length(numeric_columns)) {
      openxlsx::addStyle(
        workbook, sheet = sheet_name, style = decimal_style,
        rows = 2L:row_count, cols = numeric_columns,
        gridExpand = TRUE, stack = TRUE
      )
    }
    column_widths <- vapply(seq_len(column_count), function(column_index) {
      values <- c(names(data)[column_index], as.character(data[[column_index]]))
      values[is.na(values)] <- ""
      max_width <- max(nchar(values, type = "width"), na.rm = TRUE) + 2L
      min(42, max(11, max_width))
    }, numeric(1))
    openxlsx::setColWidths(
      workbook, sheet = sheet_name, cols = seq_len(column_count),
      widths = column_widths
    )
  }

  workbook$worksheets_rels <- lapply(
    workbook$worksheets_rels,
    function(x) x[grepl("printerSettings", x, fixed = TRUE)]
  )
  workbook$Content_Types <- workbook$Content_Types[
    !grepl("/xl/drawings/", workbook$Content_Types, fixed = TRUE)
  ]
  openxlsx::saveWorkbook(workbook, path, overwrite = TRUE)
  invisible(path)
}
```

```{r load-saved-results, include=FALSE, eval=use_saved_results}
load_saved_display <- function(path, input_path) {
  saved <- load_single_object(path, "fit_s3_4_adjusted_distress")
  stopifnot(is.list(saved), is.list(saved$metadata))
  metadata <- saved$metadata
  stopifnot(
    identical(metadata$input_md5, unname(tools::md5sum(input_path))),
    isTRUE(metadata$observations == 17755L), isTRUE(metadata$clusters == 209L),
    identical(metadata$estimator, "MLR"),
    length(metadata$mplus_version) == 1L,
    metadata$mplus_version %in% c("8.7", "9")
  )
  stopifnot(identical(metadata$upstream_s3_3_md5,
                      unname(tools::md5sum(s3_3_result_file))))
  fields <- c("variable_map", "model_fit", "raw_full_paths", "standardized_full_paths", "standardized_contrasts", "r_squared", "mlr_model_comparison", "coefficient_comparison", "r2_comparison", "diagnostics", "predictor_correlations", "duration_linearity", "residual_diagnostics", "duration_context", "diagnostic_flags")
  stopifnot(all(fields %in% names(saved)))
  tables <- saved[fields]
  predictor <- saved$predictor_diagnostics
  stopifnot(is.data.frame(predictor), all(c("model", "level", "diagnostic_type",
    "variable", "r_squared_from_other_predictors", "vif", "condition_index") %in% names(predictor)))
  tables$vif_diagnostics <- predictor[predictor$diagnostic_type == "VIF",
    c("model", "level", "variable", "r_squared_from_other_predictors", "vif"), drop = FALSE]
  tables$condition_diagnostics <- predictor[predictor$diagnostic_type == "Condition index",
    c("model", "level", "condition_index"), drop = FALSE]
  influence <- saved$influence_diagnostics
  stopifnot(is.data.frame(influence),
    all(c("level", "maximum_absolute_change") %in% names(influence)),
    all(is.finite(influence$maximum_absolute_change)))
  tables$influence_public_summary <- influence |>
    dplyr::group_by(level) |>
    dplyr::summarise(maximum_absolute_change = max(maximum_absolute_change), .groups = "drop")
  # Raw message text can contain individual cluster identifiers.
  tables$diagnostics <- public_model_diagnostics(tables$diagnostics)
  expected_rows <- c(variable_map = 32L, model_fit = 3L, raw_full_paths = 10L, standardized_full_paths = 10L, standardized_contrasts = 2L, r_squared = 6L, mlr_model_comparison = 1L, coefficient_comparison = 6L, r2_comparison = 2L, diagnostics = 3L, predictor_correlations = 20L, duration_linearity = 60L, residual_diagnostics = 2L, duration_context = 3L, diagnostic_flags = 6L, vif_diagnostics = 18L, condition_diagnostics = 3L, influence_public_summary = 2L)
  stopifnot(setequal(names(tables), names(expected_rows)))
  required_columns <- list(
    variable_map = c("representation", "mplus_variable", "project_variable"),
    model_fit = c("model_id", "representation", "restricted", "standardized", "mplus_version", "estimator", "observations", "clusters", "free_parameters", "scaled_chi_square", "scaling_correction", "df", "p_value", "cfi", "tli", "rmsea", "srmr_within", "srmr_between", "loglikelihood", "aic", "bic", "adjusted_bic"),
    raw_full_paths = c("model_id", "representation", "scale", "level", "outcome", "predictor", "path_type", "estimate", "se", "z", "p_value", "ci_lower", "ci_upper"),
    standardized_full_paths = c("model_id", "representation", "scale", "level", "outcome", "predictor", "path_type", "estimate", "se", "z", "p_value", "ci_lower", "ci_upper"),
    standardized_contrasts = c("model_id", "representation", "scale", "level", "contrast", "estimate", "se", "z", "p_value", "ci_lower", "ci_upper"),
    r_squared = c("model_id", "representation", "level", "outcome", "r_squared"),
    mlr_model_comparison = c("comparison", "restricted_model", "full_model", "restricted_df", "full_df", "df_difference", "restricted_scaling_correction", "full_scaling_correction", "difference_scaling_correction", "scaled_lr_statistic", "p_value", "free_parameter_difference", "interpretation"),
    coefficient_comparison = c("level", "term", "unadjusted_estimate", "unadjusted_se", "unadjusted_p_value", "unadjusted_ci_lower", "unadjusted_ci_upper", "adjusted_estimate", "adjusted_se", "adjusted_p_value", "adjusted_ci_lower", "adjusted_ci_upper", "absolute_change", "change_in_absolute_magnitude", "percent_change", "percentage_interpretable", "pattern", "note"),
    r2_comparison = c("level", "unadjusted_r_squared", "adjusted_r_squared", "absolute_r_squared_change", "relative_r_squared_change_percent"),
    diagnostics = c("model_id", "representation", "normal_termination", "errors_n", "warnings_n", "minimum_residual_variance", "residual_variances_positive", "required_focal_paths", "required_duration_paths", "required_contrasts", "restriction_verified", "restricted_duration_estimates_zero", "expected_focal_paths_present", "expected_duration_paths_present", "expected_contrasts_present", "technical_pass", "warning_summary"),
    predictor_correlations = c("level", "variable_1", "variable_2", "correlation"),
    duration_linearity = c("bin", "level", "engagement_mode", "n", "mean_partial_predictor", "mean_partial_distress"),
    residual_diagnostics = c("level", "n", "mean", "sd", "rmse", "skewness", "excess_kurtosis", "minimum", "maximum", "maximum_absolute"),
    duration_context = c("variable", "behavior", "n_observed", "mean_minutes", "sd_minutes", "median_minutes", "minimum", "maximum", "zero_percent", "endpoint_300_count", "skewness", "excess_kurtosis"),
    diagnostic_flags = c("diagnostic", "flagged"),
    vif_diagnostics = c("model", "level", "variable", "r_squared_from_other_predictors", "vif"),
    condition_diagnostics = c("model", "level", "condition_index"),
    influence_public_summary = c("level", "maximum_absolute_change")
  )
  for (name in names(tables)) {
    table <- tables[[name]]
    stopifnot(is.data.frame(table), nrow(table) == expected_rows[[name]],
      identical(names(table), required_columns[[name]]),
      !anyDuplicated(names(table)),
      !any(grepl("^(Name_ID|Data_ID|cluster_id|rank|warning_text|error_text)$",
                 names(table), ignore.case = TRUE)))
  }
  stopifnot(
    nrow(tables$model_fit) == 3L,
    all(tables$model_fit$observations == metadata$observations),
    all(tables$model_fit$clusters == metadata$clusters),
    all(tables$model_fit$estimator == metadata$estimator),
    all(tables$model_fit$mplus_version == metadata$mplus_version),
    length(tables$diagnostics$technical_pass) == 3L,
    all(tables$diagnostics$technical_pass),
    all(tables$r_squared$r_squared >= 0 & tables$r_squared$r_squared <= 1),
    file.exists(figure_file)
  )
  tables
}
```

```{r load-and-validate-input, eval=!use_saved_results}
  nrow(dat_s34) == 17755L,
```

```{r prepare-mplus-data, eval=!use_saved_results}
make_mplus_data <- function(map) {
  output <- dat_s34[unname(map)]
  names(output) <- names(map)
  output$id <- as.integer(factor(output$id, levels = sort(unique(output$id))))
  stopifnot(!anyNA(output), nrow(output) == expected_observations)
  as.data.frame(output)
}
mplus_data_raw <- make_mplus_data(raw_map)
mplus_data_standardized <- make_mplus_data(standardized_map)

  data.frame(
    representation = "Raw", mplus_variable = names(raw_map),
    project_variable = unname(raw_map), stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ),
  data.frame(
    representation = "Level-standardized",
    mplus_variable = names(standardized_map),
    project_variable = unname(standardized_map), stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
)
```

# Define and run restricted, raw-full, and standardized-full Mplus models

```{r run-mplus-models, eval=!use_saved_results}
raw_variable_block <- paste(
  "CLUSTER = id;",
  "WITHIN = disw corew periw intw actw pasw dayc tm2 tm3;",
  "BETWEEN = disb coreb perib intb actb pasb;",
  sep = "\n"
)
standardized_variable_block <- paste(
  "CLUSTER = id;",
  paste(
    "WITHIN = diswz corewz periwz intwz actwz paswz",
    "dayc tm2 tm3;"
  ),
  "BETWEEN = disbz corebz peribz intbz actbz pasbz;",
  sep = "\n"
)

raw_restricted_model <- paste(
  "%WITHIN%",
  "disw ON corew (wc);",
  "disw ON periw (wp);",
  "disw ON intw@0;",
  "disw ON actw@0;",
  "disw ON pasw@0;",
  "disw ON dayc;",
  "disw ON tm2;",
  "disw ON tm3;",
  "%BETWEEN%",
  "disb ON coreb (bc);",
  "disb ON perib (bp);",
  "disb ON intb@0;",
  "disb ON actb@0;",
  "disb ON pasb@0;",
  sep = "\n"
)
raw_full_model <- paste(
  "%WITHIN%",
  "disw ON corew (wc);",
  "disw ON periw (wp);",
  "disw ON intw (wi);",
  "disw ON actw (wa);",
  "disw ON pasw (wb);",
  "disw ON dayc;",
  "disw ON tm2;",
  "disw ON tm3;",
  "%BETWEEN%",
  "disb ON coreb (bc);",
  "disb ON perib (bp);",
  "disb ON intb (bi);",
  "disb ON actb (ba);",
  "disb ON pasb (bb);",
  sep = "\n"
)
standardized_full_model <- paste(
  "%WITHIN%",
  "diswz ON corewz (wc);",
  "diswz ON periwz (wp);",
  "diswz ON intwz (wi);",
  "diswz ON actwz (wa);",
  "diswz ON paswz (wb);",
  "diswz ON dayc;",
  "diswz ON tm2;",
  "diswz ON tm3;",
  "%BETWEEN%",
  "disbz ON corebz (bc);",
  "disbz ON peribz (bp);",
  "disbz ON intbz (bi);",
  "disbz ON actbz (ba);",
  "disbz ON pasbz (bb);",
  sep = "\n"
)

model_specifications <- list(
  restricted_raw = list(
    id = "S3_4_RESTRICTED_RAW",
    label = "Raw same-variable-set duration paths fixed to zero",
    stem = "s3_4_distress_restricted_raw",
    data = mplus_data_raw,
    usevariables = names(raw_map),
    variable = raw_variable_block,
    model = raw_restricted_model,
    restricted = TRUE,
    standardized = FALSE
  ),
  full_raw = list(
    id = "S3_4_FULL_RAW",
    label = "Raw full engagement-adjusted model",
    stem = "s3_4_distress_full_raw",
    data = mplus_data_raw,
    usevariables = names(raw_map),
    variable = raw_variable_block,
    model = raw_full_model,
    restricted = FALSE,
    standardized = FALSE
  ),
  full_standardized = list(
    id = "S3_4_FULL_STD",
    label = "Level-standardized full focal model",
    stem = "s3_4_distress_full_standardized",
    data = mplus_data_standardized,
    usevariables = names(standardized_map),
    variable = standardized_variable_block,
    model = standardized_full_model,
    restricted = FALSE,
    standardized = TRUE
  )
)

model_constraint <- paste(
  "NEW(wdiff bdiff);",
  "wdiff = wc - wp;",
  "bdiff = bc - bp;",
  sep = "\n"
)

run_mplus_model <- function(specification) {
  data_path <- file.path(mplus_directory, paste0(specification$stem, ".dat"))
  input_path <- file.path(mplus_directory, paste0(specification$stem, ".inp"))
  output_path <- file.path(mplus_directory, paste0(specification$stem, ".out"))

  mplus_object <- MplusAutomation::mplusObject(
    TITLE = paste(
      "! Author: Kunru Song",
      "! Step 3.4 complete Distress model with raw-minute Engagement Time.",
      "! Concurrent association; engagement adjustment is not mediation.",
      specification$label,
      sep = "\n"
    ),
    VARIABLE = specification$variable,
    ANALYSIS = paste("TYPE = TWOLEVEL;", "ESTIMATOR = MLR;", sep = "\n"),
    MODEL = specification$model,
    MODELCONSTRAINT = model_constraint,
    OUTPUT = paste(
      "SAMPSTAT;", "STANDARDIZED(STDYX);", "CINTERVAL;",
      "RESIDUAL;", "TECH1;", "TECH4;", sep = "\n"
    ),
    usevariables = specification$usevariables,
    rdata = specification$data,
    autov = FALSE,
    quiet = TRUE
  )

  modeler_result <- MplusAutomation::mplusModeler(
    object = mplus_object,
    dataout = data_path,
    modelout = input_path,
    run = 1L,
    check = FALSE,
    varwarnings = TRUE,
    Mplus_command = mplus_command,
    writeData = "always",
    hashfilename = FALSE,
    killOnFail = TRUE,
    quiet = TRUE
  )

  stopifnot(file.exists(data_path), file.exists(input_path), file.exists(output_path))
  input_lines <- readLines(input_path, warn = FALSE)
  output_lines <- readLines(output_path, warn = FALSE)
  parsed <- MplusAutomation::readModels(output_path, what = "all", quiet = TRUE)
  fixed_zero_patterns <- c("intw@0", "actw@0", "pasw@0", "intb@0", "actb@0", "pasb@0")
  checks <- list(
    author_present = any(trimws(input_lines) == "! Author: Kunru Song"),
    missing_declared = any(grepl(
      "MISSING\\s*=\\s*\\.;", input_lines, ignore.case = TRUE, perl = TRUE
    )),
    twolevel_declared = any(grepl(
      "TYPE\\s*=\\s*TWOLEVEL;", input_lines, ignore.case = TRUE, perl = TRUE
    )),
    mlr_declared = any(grepl(
      "ESTIMATOR\\s*=\\s*MLR;", input_lines, ignore.case = TRUE, perl = TRUE
    )),
    cluster_declared = any(grepl(
      "CLUSTER\\s*=\\s*id;", input_lines, ignore.case = TRUE, perl = TRUE
    )),
    constraint_declared = any(grepl(
      "MODEL CONSTRAINT", input_lines, ignore.case = TRUE, fixed = TRUE
    )),
    normal_termination = any(grepl(
      "THE MODEL ESTIMATION TERMINATED NORMALLY", output_lines, fixed = TRUE
    )),
    restriction_matches_specification = if (specification$restricted) {
      all(vapply(fixed_zero_patterns, function(pattern) {
        any(grepl(pattern, input_lines, ignore.case = TRUE, fixed = TRUE))
      }, logical(1)))
    } else {
      !any(vapply(fixed_zero_patterns, function(pattern) {
        any(grepl(pattern, input_lines, ignore.case = TRUE, fixed = TRUE))
      }, logical(1)))
    }
  )
  summary_row <- parsed$summaries[1, , drop = FALSE]
  checks$mplus_8_7 <- identical(
    summary_value(summary_row, "Mplus.version", "character"), "8.7"
  )
  checks$estimator_mlr <- identical(
    summary_value(summary_row, "Estimator", "character"), "MLR"
  )
  checks$observations_match <-
    as.integer(summary_value(summary_row, "Observations", "numeric")) ==
      expected_observations
  checks$clusters_match <-
    parse_output_integer(output_path, "Number of clusters") == expected_clusters
  stopifnot(all(unlist(checks)))

  list(
    model_id = specification$id,
    model_label = specification$label,
    restricted = specification$restricted,
    standardized = specification$standardized,
    syntax = list(
      variable = specification$variable,
      model = specification$model,
      constraint = model_constraint
    ),
    paths = list(data = data_path, input = input_path, output = output_path),
    file_md5 = unname(tools::md5sum(c(data_path, input_path, output_path))),
    checks = checks,
    parsed = parsed,
    modeler_result = modeler_result,
    warnings = flatten_messages(parsed$warnings),
    errors = flatten_messages(parsed$errors)
  )
}

model_runs <- lapply(model_specifications, run_mplus_model)
```

# Extract paths, contrasts, fit, R-squared, and the scaled MLR comparison

Full warning/error text is kept in the local result object because it can contain
individual cluster identifiers. The public table retains warning/error flags and
an aggregate warning description. Fit indices for saturated models (df = 0) are
not interpreted.

```{r extract-results, eval=!use_saved_results}
extract_fit <- function(run) {
  s <- run$parsed$summaries[1, , drop = FALSE]
  data.frame(
    model_id = run$model_id,
    representation = run$model_label,
    restricted = run$restricted,
    standardized = run$standardized,
    mplus_version = summary_value(s, "Mplus.version", "character"),
    estimator = summary_value(s, "Estimator", "character"),
    observations = summary_value(s, "Observations", "numeric"),
    clusters = parse_output_integer(run$paths$output, "Number of clusters"),
    free_parameters = summary_value(s, "Parameters", "numeric"),
    scaled_chi_square = summary_value(s, "ChiSqM_Value", "numeric"),
    scaling_correction = summary_value(s, "ChiSqM_ScalingCorrection", "numeric"),
    df = summary_value(s, "ChiSqM_DF", "numeric"),
    p_value = summary_value(s, "ChiSqM_PValue", "numeric"),
    cfi = summary_value(s, "CFI", "numeric"),
    tli = summary_value(s, "TLI", "numeric"),
    rmsea = summary_value(s, "RMSEA_Estimate", "numeric"),
    srmr_within = summary_value(
      s, c("SRMR.Within", "SRMR_Within", "SRMRWithin"), "numeric"
    ),
    srmr_between = summary_value(
      s, c("SRMR.Between", "SRMR_Between", "SRMRBetween"), "numeric"
    ),
    loglikelihood = summary_value(s, "LL", "numeric"),
    aic = summary_value(s, "AIC", "numeric"),
    bic = summary_value(s, "BIC", "numeric"),
    adjusted_bic = summary_value(s, "aBIC", "numeric"),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

outcome_dictionary <- c(
  DISW = "Distress", DISB = "Distress",
  DISWZ = "Distress", DISBZ = "Distress"
)
predictor_dictionary <- c(
  COREW = "Core", PERIW = "Peripheral",
  INTW = "Interactive/message", ACTW = "Active/posting", PASW = "Passive/browsing",
  COREB = "Core", PERIB = "Peripheral",
  INTB = "Interactive/message", ACTB = "Active/posting", PASB = "Passive/browsing",
  COREWZ = "Core", PERIWZ = "Peripheral",
  INTWZ = "Interactive/message", ACTWZ = "Active/posting", PASWZ = "Passive/browsing",
  COREBZ = "Core", PERIBZ = "Peripheral",
  INTBZ = "Interactive/message", ACTBZ = "Active/posting", PASBZ = "Passive/browsing"
)
path_type_dictionary <- c(
  COREW = "Core/Peripheral", PERIW = "Core/Peripheral",
  COREB = "Core/Peripheral", PERIB = "Core/Peripheral",
  COREWZ = "Core/Peripheral", PERIWZ = "Core/Peripheral",
  COREBZ = "Core/Peripheral", PERIBZ = "Core/Peripheral",
  INTW = "Engagement Time", ACTW = "Engagement Time", PASW = "Engagement Time",
  INTB = "Engagement Time", ACTB = "Engagement Time", PASB = "Engagement Time",
  INTWZ = "Engagement Time", ACTWZ = "Engagement Time", PASWZ = "Engagement Time",
  INTBZ = "Engagement Time", ACTBZ = "Engagement Time", PASBZ = "Engagement Time"
)

extract_paths <- function(run) {
  parameters <- run$parsed$parameters$unstandardized |>
    dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(
      dplyr::any_of(c("est", "se", "est_se", "pval")), mplus_numeric
    ))
  ci <- run$parsed$parameters$ci.unstandardized
  if (!is.null(ci) && nrow(ci)) {
    ci <- ci |>
      dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(
        dplyr::any_of(c("low2.5", "up2.5")), mplus_numeric
      )) |>
      dplyr::select(dplyr::any_of(c(
        "paramHeader", "param", "BetweenWithin", "low2.5", "up2.5"
      )))
  }
  paths <- parameters |>
    dplyr::filter(grepl("\\.ON$", paramHeader)) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      outcome_code = sub("\\.ON$", "", paramHeader),
      predictor_code = param,
      outcome = unname(outcome_dictionary[outcome_code]),
      predictor = unname(predictor_dictionary[predictor_code]),
      path_type = unname(path_type_dictionary[predictor_code])
    ) |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(outcome), !is.na(predictor)) |>
    dplyr::select(
      paramHeader, param, BetweenWithin, outcome_code, outcome,
      predictor, path_type, estimate = est, se, z = est_se, p_value = pval
    )
  if (!is.null(ci) && nrow(ci)) {
    paths <- paths |>
      dplyr::left_join(ci, by = c("paramHeader", "param", "BetweenWithin")) |>
      dplyr::rename(ci_lower = low2.5, ci_upper = up2.5)
  } else {
    paths$ci_lower <- paths$estimate - 1.96 * paths$se
    paths$ci_upper <- paths$estimate + 1.96 * paths$se
  }
  paths |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      model_id = run$model_id,
      representation = run$model_label,
      level = ifelse(grepl("B$|BZ$", outcome_code), "Between", "Within"),
      scale = ifelse(grepl("Z$", outcome_code), "Standardized", "Raw")
    ) |>
    dplyr::select(
      model_id, representation, scale, level, outcome, predictor, path_type,
      estimate, se, z, p_value, ci_lower, ci_upper
    )
}

contrast_dictionary <- data.frame(
  param = c("WDIFF", "BDIFF"), level = c("Within", "Between"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
extract_contrasts <- function(run) {
  run$parsed$parameters$unstandardized |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      dplyr::across(
        dplyr::any_of(c("est", "se", "est_se", "pval")), mplus_numeric
      ),
      param_upper = toupper(param)
    ) |>
    dplyr::filter(param_upper %in% contrast_dictionary$param) |>
    dplyr::left_join(contrast_dictionary, by = c("param_upper" = "param")) |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      model_id = run$model_id,
      representation = run$model_label,
      scale = ifelse(run$standardized, "Standardized", "Raw"),
      level,
      contrast = "Core slope - Peripheral slope",
      estimate = est, se, z = est_se, p_value = pval,
      ci_lower = est - 1.96 * se,
      ci_upper = est + 1.96 * se
    )
}

extract_r2 <- function(run) {
  r2 <- run$parsed$parameters$r2
  if (is.null(r2) || !nrow(r2)) return(data.frame())
  r2 |>
    dplyr::mutate(est = mplus_numeric(est), param_upper = toupper(param)) |>
    dplyr::filter(param_upper %in% names(outcome_dictionary)) |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      model_id = run$model_id,
      representation = run$model_label,
      level = ifelse(grepl("B$|BZ$", param_upper), "Between", "Within"),
      outcome = "Distress", r_squared = est
    )
}

model_fit <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(model_runs, extract_fit))
paths <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(model_runs, extract_paths))
contrasts <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(model_runs, extract_contrasts))
r_squared <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(model_runs, extract_r2))

diagnostics <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(model_runs, function(run) {
  residuals <- run$parsed$parameters$unstandardized |>
    dplyr::mutate(est = mplus_numeric(est)) |>
    dplyr::filter(paramHeader == "Residual.Variances")
  data.frame(
    model_id = run$model_id,
    representation = run$model_label,
    normal_termination = run$checks$normal_termination,
    errors_n = ifelse(nzchar(run$errors), 1L, 0L),
    warnings_n = ifelse(nzchar(run$warnings), 1L, 0L),
    minimum_residual_variance = if (nrow(residuals)) min(residuals$est) else NA_real_,
    residual_variances_positive = if (nrow(residuals)) all(residuals$est > 0) else FALSE,
    required_focal_paths = sum(
      paths$model_id == run$model_id & paths$path_type == "Core/Peripheral"
    ),
    required_duration_paths = sum(
      paths$model_id == run$model_id & paths$path_type == "Engagement Time"
    ),
    required_contrasts = sum(contrasts$model_id == run$model_id),
    restriction_verified = run$checks$restriction_matches_specification,
    restricted_duration_estimates_zero = if (run$restricted) {
      duration_estimates <- paths |>
        dplyr::filter(
          model_id == run$model_id, path_type == "Engagement Time"
        ) |>
        dplyr::pull(estimate)
      length(duration_estimates) == 6L && all(duration_estimates == 0)
    } else {
      TRUE
    },
    warning_text = run$warnings,
    error_text = ifelse(nzchar(run$errors), run$errors, "None"),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
})) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    expected_focal_paths_present = required_focal_paths == 4L,
    expected_duration_paths_present =
      ifelse(model_id == "S3_4_RESTRICTED_RAW", TRUE, required_duration_paths == 6L),
    expected_contrasts_present = required_contrasts == 2L,
    technical_pass = normal_termination & errors_n == 0L &
      residual_variances_positive & expected_focal_paths_present &
      expected_duration_paths_present & expected_contrasts_present &
      restriction_verified & restricted_duration_estimates_zero
  )

raw_full_paths <- paths |> dplyr::filter(model_id == "S3_4_FULL_RAW")
standardized_full_paths <- paths |> dplyr::filter(model_id == "S3_4_FULL_STD")
standardized_contrasts <- contrasts |> dplyr::filter(model_id == "S3_4_FULL_STD")
sign_agreement <- raw_full_paths |>
  dplyr::select(
    level, predictor, path_type, raw_estimate = estimate, raw_z = z
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    standardized_full_paths |>
      dplyr::select(
        level, predictor, path_type,
        standardized_estimate = estimate, standardized_z = z
      ),
    by = c("level", "predictor", "path_type")
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    # Mplus prints very small raw-minute slopes as 0.000; z retains their sign.
    sign_agrees = sign(raw_z) == sign(standardized_z)
  )

standardization_constants <- dat_step3_concurrent$standardization
predictor_variable_map <- c(
  Core = "Core", Peripheral = "Peripheral",
  `Interactive/message` = "InteractiveTime",
  `Active/posting` = "ActiveTime",
  `Passive/browsing` = "PassiveTime"
)
raw_scale_interpretation <- standardized_full_paths |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    outcome_sd = ifelse(
      level == "Within",
      standardization_constants$within_sd[
        standardization_constants$variable == "Distress"
      ],
      standardization_constants$between_sd[
        standardization_constants$variable == "Distress"
      ]
    ),
    predictor_variable = unname(predictor_variable_map[predictor]),
    predictor_sd = vapply(seq_len(dplyr::n()), function(row) {
      variable <- predictor_variable[[row]]
      if (level[[row]] == "Within") {
        standardization_constants$within_sd[
          standardization_constants$variable == variable
        ]
      } else {
        standardization_constants$between_sd[
          standardization_constants$variable == variable
        ]
      }
    }, numeric(1)),
    raw_scale_multiplier = outcome_sd / predictor_sd,
    estimate_per_raw_unit = estimate * raw_scale_multiplier,
    se_per_raw_unit = se * raw_scale_multiplier,
    ci_lower_per_raw_unit = ci_lower * raw_scale_multiplier,
    ci_upper_per_raw_unit = ci_upper * raw_scale_multiplier,
    raw_unit = ifelse(
      path_type == "Engagement Time", "Per 1 raw minute", "Per 1 mean-score point"
    ),
    estimate_per_10_minutes = ifelse(
      path_type == "Engagement Time", estimate_per_raw_unit * 10, NA_real_
    ),
    ci_lower_per_10_minutes = ifelse(
      path_type == "Engagement Time", ci_lower_per_raw_unit * 10, NA_real_
    ),
    ci_upper_per_10_minutes = ifelse(
      path_type == "Engagement Time", ci_upper_per_raw_unit * 10, NA_real_
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(
    level, predictor, path_type, raw_unit,
    estimate_per_raw_unit, se_per_raw_unit,
    ci_lower_per_raw_unit, ci_upper_per_raw_unit,
    estimate_per_10_minutes, ci_lower_per_10_minutes,
    ci_upper_per_10_minutes
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    raw_full_paths |>
      dplyr::select(
        level, predictor, path_type, mplus_printed_raw_estimate = estimate
      ),
    by = c("level", "predictor", "path_type")
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    reconstruction_minus_mplus_printed =
      estimate_per_raw_unit - mplus_printed_raw_estimate,
    reconstruction_note = paste(
      "Reconstructed from the level-standardized Mplus path and S3.1 SDs;",
      "used because Mplus prints raw slopes to three decimals"
    )
  )

restricted_fit <- model_fit |>
  dplyr::filter(model_id == "S3_4_RESTRICTED_RAW")
full_fit <- model_fit |>
  dplyr::filter(model_id == "S3_4_FULL_RAW")
df_difference <- restricted_fit$df - full_fit$df
difference_scaling_correction <- (
  restricted_fit$df * restricted_fit$scaling_correction -
    full_fit$df * full_fit$scaling_correction
) / df_difference
scaled_lr_statistic <- (
  restricted_fit$scaled_chi_square * restricted_fit$scaling_correction -
    full_fit$scaled_chi_square * full_fit$scaling_correction
) / difference_scaling_correction
mlr_model_comparison <- data.frame(
  comparison = "Six Engagement Time paths jointly fixed to zero vs freely estimated",
  restricted_model = restricted_fit$model_id,
  full_model = full_fit$model_id,
  restricted_df = restricted_fit$df,
  full_df = full_fit$df,
  df_difference = df_difference,
  restricted_scaling_correction = restricted_fit$scaling_correction,
  full_scaling_correction = full_fit$scaling_correction,
  difference_scaling_correction = difference_scaling_correction,
  scaled_lr_statistic = scaled_lr_statistic,
  p_value = stats::pchisq(
    scaled_lr_statistic, df = df_difference, lower.tail = FALSE
  ),
  free_parameter_difference =
    full_fit$free_parameters - restricted_fit$free_parameters,
  interpretation = paste(
    "Joint test of three within-person and three between-person duration paths;",
    "not a mediation test"
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

stopifnot(
  nrow(model_fit) == 3L,
  nrow(raw_full_paths) == 10L,
  nrow(standardized_full_paths) == 10L,
  nrow(standardized_contrasts) == 2L,
  nrow(r_squared) == 6L,
  all(diagnostics$technical_pass),
  all(sign_agreement$sign_agrees),
  all(r_squared$r_squared >= 0 & r_squared$r_squared <= 1),
  mlr_model_comparison$df_difference == 6L,
  mlr_model_comparison$free_parameter_difference == 6L,
  mlr_model_comparison$difference_scaling_correction > 0,
  mlr_model_comparison$scaled_lr_statistic >= 0
)
```

# Same-sample S3.3 versus S3.4 coefficient and R-squared comparison

```{r compare-unadjusted-adjusted, eval=!use_saved_results}
s3_3_terms <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  fit_s3_3_unadjusted_distress$standardized_paths |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      level, term = predictor, unadjusted_estimate = estimate,
      unadjusted_se = se, unadjusted_p_value = p_value,
      unadjusted_ci_lower = ci_lower, unadjusted_ci_upper = ci_upper
    ),
  fit_s3_3_unadjusted_distress$standardized_contrasts |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      level, term = "Core - Peripheral", unadjusted_estimate = estimate,
      unadjusted_se = se, unadjusted_p_value = p_value,
      unadjusted_ci_lower = ci_lower, unadjusted_ci_upper = ci_upper
    )
)
s3_4_terms <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  standardized_full_paths |>
    dplyr::filter(path_type == "Core/Peripheral") |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      level, term = predictor, adjusted_estimate = estimate,
      adjusted_se = se, adjusted_p_value = p_value,
      adjusted_ci_lower = ci_lower, adjusted_ci_upper = ci_upper
    ),
  standardized_contrasts |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      level, term = "Core - Peripheral", adjusted_estimate = estimate,
      adjusted_se = se, adjusted_p_value = p_value,
      adjusted_ci_lower = ci_lower, adjusted_ci_upper = ci_upper
    )
)

coefficient_comparison <- s3_3_terms |>
  dplyr::left_join(s3_4_terms, by = c("level", "term")) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    absolute_change = adjusted_estimate - unadjusted_estimate,
    change_in_absolute_magnitude =
      abs(adjusted_estimate) - abs(unadjusted_estimate),
    percent_change = 100 * absolute_change / abs(unadjusted_estimate),
    percentage_interpretable = abs(unadjusted_estimate) >= 0.05,
    pattern = dplyr::case_when(
      abs(absolute_change) < 0.005 ~ "Essentially unchanged (<0.005)",
      abs(adjusted_estimate) < abs(unadjusted_estimate) ~ "Attenuated",
      abs(adjusted_estimate) > abs(unadjusted_estimate) ~ "Strengthened",
      TRUE ~ "Unchanged"
    ),
    note = ifelse(
      percentage_interpretable,
      "Percentage change shown",
      "Small unadjusted denominator; prioritize absolute change"
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(
    factor(level, levels = c("Within", "Between")),
    factor(term, levels = c("Core", "Peripheral", "Core - Peripheral"))
  )

s3_3_r2 <- fit_s3_3_unadjusted_distress$r_squared |>
  dplyr::filter(model_id == "S3_3_STD") |>
  dplyr::select(level, unadjusted_r_squared = r_squared)
s3_4_r2 <- r_squared |>
  dplyr::filter(model_id == "S3_4_FULL_STD") |>
  dplyr::select(level, adjusted_r_squared = r_squared)
r2_comparison <- s3_3_r2 |>
  dplyr::left_join(s3_4_r2, by = "level") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    absolute_r_squared_change = adjusted_r_squared - unadjusted_r_squared,
    relative_r_squared_change_percent =
      100 * absolute_r_squared_change / unadjusted_r_squared
  )

stopifnot(
  nrow(coefficient_comparison) == 6L,
  !anyNA(coefficient_comparison[c("unadjusted_estimate", "adjusted_estimate")]),
  nrow(r2_comparison) == 2L
)
```

# Full-model predictor, linearity, residual, and influence diagnostics

The following R regressions are diagnostic companions on the identical fixed
sample. Canonical estimates and inference come from the Mplus MLR models;
current reproduction uses Mplus 8.7. Cluster-specific influence records remain
in the local result object and workbook. The public report shows only the
largest absolute Core, Peripheral or contrast change at each level, without
participant identifiers or rankings.

```{r diagnostic-audit, eval=!use_saved_results}
between_data <- dat_s34 |>
  dplyr::select(
    Name_ID, Distress_B, Core_B, Peripheral_B,
    InteractiveTime_B, ActiveTime_B, PassiveTime_B,
    Distress_B_Z, Core_B_Z, Peripheral_B_Z,
    InteractiveTime_B_Z, ActiveTime_B_Z, PassiveTime_B_Z
  ) |>
  dplyr::distinct() |>
  as.data.frame()
stopifnot(nrow(between_data) == expected_clusters)

within_full <- c(
  "Core_W", "Peripheral_W", "InteractiveTime_W",
  "ActiveTime_W", "PassiveTime_W"
)
within_full_design <- c(within_full, "Day_c", "Time_2", "Time_3")
between_full <- c(
  "Core_B", "Peripheral_B", "InteractiveTime_B",
  "ActiveTime_B", "PassiveTime_B"
)
vif_diagnostics <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  vif_table(dat_s34, within_full, "Within", "S3.4 full predictors"),
  vif_table(dat_s34, within_full_design, "Within", "S3.4 including Time/Day"),
  vif_table(between_data, between_full, "Between", "S3.4 full predictors")
)
condition_diagnostics <- data.frame(
  model = c(
    "S3.4 full predictors", "S3.4 including Time/Day",
    "S3.4 full predictors"
  ),
  level = c("Within", "Within", "Between"),
  condition_index = c(
    condition_index(dat_s34, within_full),
    condition_index(dat_s34, within_full_design),
    condition_index(between_data, between_full)
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

correlation_pairs <- function(data, variables, level_label) {
  matrix <- stats::cor(data[variables], use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
  indices <- which(upper.tri(matrix), arr.ind = TRUE)
  data.frame(
    level = level_label,
    variable_1 = rownames(matrix)[indices[, 1]],
    variable_2 = colnames(matrix)[indices[, 2]],
    correlation = matrix[indices], stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}
predictor_correlations <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  correlation_pairs(dat_s34, within_full, "Within"),
  correlation_pairs(between_data, between_full, "Between")
)

partial_binned_summary <- function(
  data, outcome, focal, adjustment, label, level_label
) {
  outcome_residual <- stats::resid(stats::lm(
    stats::reformulate(adjustment, response = outcome), data = data
  ))
  predictor_residual <- stats::resid(stats::lm(
    stats::reformulate(adjustment, response = focal), data = data
  ))
  data.frame(
    partial_predictor = predictor_residual,
    partial_distress = outcome_residual
  ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(bin = dplyr::ntile(partial_predictor, 10L)) |>
    dplyr::group_by(bin) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      level = .env$level_label,
      engagement_mode = .env$label,
      n = dplyr::n(),
      mean_partial_predictor = mean(partial_predictor),
      mean_partial_distress = mean(partial_distress),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

within_standardized_predictors <- c(
  "Core_W_Z", "Peripheral_W_Z", "InteractiveTime_W_Z",
  "ActiveTime_W_Z", "PassiveTime_W_Z"
)
between_standardized_predictors <- c(
  "Core_B_Z", "Peripheral_B_Z", "InteractiveTime_B_Z",
  "ActiveTime_B_Z", "PassiveTime_B_Z"
)
duration_linearity <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(
    names(c(
      InteractiveTime_W_Z = "Interactive/message",
      ActiveTime_W_Z = "Active/posting",
      PassiveTime_W_Z = "Passive/browsing"
    )),
    function(focal) {
      labels <- c(
        InteractiveTime_W_Z = "Interactive/message",
        ActiveTime_W_Z = "Active/posting",
        PassiveTime_W_Z = "Passive/browsing"
      )
      partial_binned_summary(
        dat_s34, "Distress_W_Z", focal,
        c(setdiff(within_standardized_predictors, focal), "Day_c", "Time_2", "Time_3"),
        labels[[focal]], "Within"
      )
    }
  )),
  dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(
    names(c(
      InteractiveTime_B_Z = "Interactive/message",
      ActiveTime_B_Z = "Active/posting",
      PassiveTime_B_Z = "Passive/browsing"
    )),
    function(focal) {
      labels <- c(
        InteractiveTime_B_Z = "Interactive/message",
        ActiveTime_B_Z = "Active/posting",
        PassiveTime_B_Z = "Passive/browsing"
      )
      partial_binned_summary(
        between_data, "Distress_B_Z", focal,
        setdiff(between_standardized_predictors, focal),
        labels[[focal]], "Between"
      )
    }
  ))
)

within_screen <- stats::lm(
  Distress_W ~ Core_W + Peripheral_W + InteractiveTime_W +
    ActiveTime_W + PassiveTime_W + Day_c + Time_2 + Time_3,
  data = dat_s34
)
between_screen <- stats::lm(
  Distress_B ~ Core_B + Peripheral_B + InteractiveTime_B +
    ActiveTime_B + PassiveTime_B,
  data = between_data
)
residual_diagnostics <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(
  list(Within = stats::resid(within_screen), Between = stats::resid(between_screen)),
  function(residual) {
    data.frame(
      n = length(residual), mean = mean(residual), sd = stats::sd(residual),
      rmse = sqrt(mean(residual^2)), skewness = skewness(residual),
      excess_kurtosis = excess_kurtosis(residual),
      minimum = min(residual), maximum = max(residual),
      maximum_absolute = max(abs(residual)), stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }
), .id = "level")

within_screen_z <- stats::lm(
  Distress_W_Z ~ Core_W_Z + Peripheral_W_Z + InteractiveTime_W_Z +
    ActiveTime_W_Z + PassiveTime_W_Z + Day_c + Time_2 + Time_3,
  data = dat_s34
)
between_screen_z <- stats::lm(
  Distress_B_Z ~ Core_B_Z + Peripheral_B_Z + InteractiveTime_B_Z +
    ActiveTime_B_Z + PassiveTime_B_Z,
  data = between_data
)
within_reference <- stats::coef(within_screen_z)[c("Core_W_Z", "Peripheral_W_Z")]
between_reference <- stats::coef(between_screen_z)[c("Core_B_Z", "Peripheral_B_Z")]

within_leave_one_cluster <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(unique(dat_s34$Name_ID), function(id) {
  fit <- stats::lm(
    Distress_W_Z ~ Core_W_Z + Peripheral_W_Z + InteractiveTime_W_Z +
      ActiveTime_W_Z + PassiveTime_W_Z + Day_c + Time_2 + Time_3,
    data = dat_s34[dat_s34$Name_ID != id, ]
  )
  coefficient <- stats::coef(fit)[c("Core_W_Z", "Peripheral_W_Z")]
  data.frame(
    level = "Within", cluster_id = as.character(id),
    core_change = coefficient[[1L]] - within_reference[[1L]],
    peripheral_change = coefficient[[2L]] - within_reference[[2L]],
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}))
between_leave_one_cluster <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(unique(between_data$Name_ID), function(id) {
  fit <- stats::lm(
    Distress_B_Z ~ Core_B_Z + Peripheral_B_Z + InteractiveTime_B_Z +
      ActiveTime_B_Z + PassiveTime_B_Z,
    data = between_data[between_data$Name_ID != id, ]
  )
  coefficient <- stats::coef(fit)[c("Core_B_Z", "Peripheral_B_Z")]
  data.frame(
    level = "Between", cluster_id = as.character(id),
    core_change = coefficient[[1L]] - between_reference[[1L]],
    peripheral_change = coefficient[[2L]] - between_reference[[2L]],
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}))
influence_diagnostics <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  within_leave_one_cluster, between_leave_one_cluster
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    contrast_change = core_change - peripheral_change,
    maximum_absolute_change = pmax(
      abs(core_change), abs(peripheral_change), abs(contrast_change)
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(level) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(maximum_absolute_change), .by_group = TRUE) |>
  dplyr::mutate(rank = dplyr::row_number()) |>
  dplyr::filter(rank <= 10L) |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::select(
    level, rank, cluster_id, core_change, peripheral_change,
    contrast_change, maximum_absolute_change
  )

duration_labels <- c(
  InteractiveTime = "Interactive/message",
  ActiveTime = "Active/posting",
  PassiveTime = "Passive/browsing"
)
duration_context <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(duration_labels), function(variable) {
  x <- dat_s34[[variable]]
  data.frame(
    variable = variable, behavior = duration_labels[[variable]],
    n_observed = length(x), mean_minutes = mean(x),
    sd_minutes = stats::sd(x), median_minutes = stats::median(x),
    minimum = min(x), maximum = max(x), zero_percent = mean(x == 0) * 100,
    endpoint_300_count = sum(x == 300), skewness = skewness(x),
    excess_kurtosis = excess_kurtosis(x), stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}))

diagnostic_flags <- data.frame(
  diagnostic = c(
    "Maximum VIF exceeds 5",
    "Maximum condition index exceeds 30",
    "Posting zero percentage differs materially from verified context",
    "Duration value outside 0-300",
    "Influence diagnostic contains non-finite change",
    "Raw and standardized full-model path signs disagree"
  ),
  flagged = c(
    max(vif_diagnostics$vif) > 5,
    max(condition_diagnostics$condition_index) > 30,
    abs(duration_context$zero_percent[duration_context$variable == "ActiveTime"] -
      75.13) > 0.10,
    any(duration_context$minimum < 0 | duration_context$maximum > 300),
    any(!is.finite(influence_diagnostics$maximum_absolute_change)),
    any(!sign_agreement$sign_agrees)
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
stopifnot(!any(diagnostic_flags$flagged))

influence_public_summary <- influence_diagnostics |>
  dplyr::group_by(level) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    maximum_absolute_change = max(maximum_absolute_change), .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r export-results, include=FALSE, eval=!use_saved_results}
plot_data <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  coefficient_comparison |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      level, term, model = "S3.3 without Engagement Time",
      estimate = unadjusted_estimate, se = unadjusted_se,
      p_value = unadjusted_p_value,
      ci_lower = unadjusted_ci_lower, ci_upper = unadjusted_ci_upper
    ),
  coefficient_comparison |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      level, term, model = "S3.4 with Engagement Time",
      estimate = adjusted_estimate, se = adjusted_se,
      p_value = adjusted_p_value,
      ci_lower = adjusted_ci_lower, ci_upper = adjusted_ci_upper
    )
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    term = factor(term, levels = c("Core", "Peripheral", "Core - Peripheral")),
    level = factor(level, levels = c("Within", "Between")),
    model = factor(
      model,
      levels = c(
        "S3.3 without Engagement Time", "S3.4 with Engagement Time"
      )
    )
  )

comparison_plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  plot_data,
  ggplot2::aes(
    x = term, y = estimate, ymin = ci_lower, ymax = ci_upper,
    color = model, group = model
  )
) +
  ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.4) +
  ggplot2::geom_pointrange(
    position = ggplot2::position_dodge(width = 0.42), linewidth = 0.45
  ) +
  ggplot2::facet_wrap(~ level, scales = "free_y") +
  ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "S3.3 without Engagement Time" = "#2C7FB8",
    "S3.4 with Engagement Time" = "#D95F0E"
  )) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    x = NULL, y = "Standardized concurrent coefficient", color = NULL,
    title = "Distress coefficients before and after Engagement Time adjustment",
    subtitle = paste(
      "Identical 17,755-prompt sample; points are Mplus MLR estimates",
      "with 95% confidence intervals"
    )
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  ggplot2::theme(
    legend.position = "top", panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    plot.title.position = "plot"
  )
```

```{r final-validation, include=FALSE, eval=!use_saved_results}
verified_result <- load_single_object(
  result_file, "fit_s3_4_adjusted_distress"
)
workbook_sheets_read <- readxl::excel_sheets(table_file)
svg_text <- readLines(figure_file, warn = FALSE)
xlsx_entries <- utils::unzip(table_file, list = TRUE)$Name
xlsx_relationship_entries <- xlsx_entries[grepl("\\.rels$", xlsx_entries)]
xlsx_relationship_text <- unlist(lapply(xlsx_relationship_entries, function(entry) {
  readLines(unz(table_file, entry), warn = FALSE)
}), use.names = FALSE)
dangling_drawing_relationship <- any(grepl(
  "relationships/(drawing|vmlDrawing)", xlsx_relationship_text
))

artifact_audit <- data.frame(
  artifact = c("Result RDA", "Workbook", "SVG figure"),
  exists = c(
    file.exists(result_file), file.exists(table_file), file.exists(figure_file)
  ),
  bytes = c(
    file.info(result_file)$size,
    file.info(table_file)$size,
    file.info(figure_file)$size
  ),
  md5 = unname(tools::md5sum(c(result_file, table_file, figure_file))),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

validation <- data.frame(
  gate = c(
    "All three Mplus models terminated normally",
    "Mplus 8.7 and MLR verified",
    "Common S3.3/S3.4 sample and 209 clusters verified",
    "Six restricted duration paths explicitly fixed and estimated at zero",
    "Four focal paths and two contrasts per model parsed",
    "Six duration paths parsed in each full model",
    "Residual variances positive",
    "R-squared admissible",
    "Raw and standardized full-model signs agree",
    "Reconstructed raw-unit slopes agree with Mplus printed rounding",
    "Scaled MLR six-path comparison valid",
    "Six same-sample coefficient-comparison rows present",
    "Multicollinearity thresholds passed",
    "Residual and influence diagnostics finite",
    "Posting zero mass and endpoints retained",
    "Workbook sheets verified",
    "Workbook has no dangling drawing relationships",
    "SVG is vector output",
    "Saved result RDA reloaded"
  ),
  passed = c(
    all(diagnostics$normal_termination),
    all(model_fit$mplus_version == "8.7" & model_fit$estimator == "MLR"),
    all(model_fit$observations == expected_observations &
      model_fit$clusters == expected_clusters),
    model_runs$restricted_raw$checks$restriction_matches_specification &&
      diagnostics$restricted_duration_estimates_zero[
        diagnostics$model_id == "S3_4_RESTRICTED_RAW"
      ],
    all(diagnostics$required_focal_paths == 4L &
      diagnostics$required_contrasts == 2L),
    all(diagnostics$required_duration_paths[
      diagnostics$model_id != "S3_4_RESTRICTED_RAW"
    ] == 6L),
    all(diagnostics$residual_variances_positive),
    all(r_squared$r_squared >= 0 & r_squared$r_squared <= 1),
    all(sign_agreement$sign_agrees),
    max(abs(raw_scale_interpretation$reconstruction_minus_mplus_printed)) < 0.0006,
    mlr_model_comparison$df_difference == 6L &&
      mlr_model_comparison$free_parameter_difference == 6L &&
      mlr_model_comparison$difference_scaling_correction > 0 &&
      is.finite(mlr_model_comparison$p_value),
    nrow(coefficient_comparison) == 6L &&
      !anyNA(coefficient_comparison[c("unadjusted_estimate", "adjusted_estimate")]),
    max(vif_diagnostics$vif) < 5 &&
      max(condition_diagnostics$condition_index) < 30,
    all(is.finite(residual_diagnostics$rmse)) &&
      all(is.finite(influence_diagnostics$maximum_absolute_change)),
    duration_context$zero_percent[duration_context$variable == "ActiveTime"] > 75 &&
      duration_context$endpoint_300_count[duration_context$variable == "ActiveTime"] == 5L,
    identical(workbook_sheets_read, names(workbook_sheets)),
    !dangling_drawing_relationship,
    any(grepl("<svg", svg_text, fixed = TRUE)) &&
      !any(grepl("<image", svg_text, fixed = TRUE)),
    identical(verified_result$metadata$observations, expected_observations)
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
stopifnot(all(artifact_audit$exists), all(validation$passed))
```
